scope: Additive Poison Lizard L1-15 numerical and target-effect audit. Preserve sourced poison fields without enabling an incomplete paired-Pet actor.
game_version: Official behavior through the 2026-01-28 balance; dated game-file table 2026-09-01, exact client build unpublished; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Full Release Notes
sources.levels: Pet House 7 onward; no numerical table
facts: Poison Lizard favors defending Heroes and Troops, targets ground and air, applies poison damage and slow to them, and falls back to the paired Hero's building target when no enemy units are nearby. The slow does not affect buildings.
sources.limitations: No exact enemy-unit search radius, target-choice tie-break, poison pulse and duration, stacking, projectile timing or paired-Hero transition is specified.

sources.title: December Balance Changes 🔜
facts: The enemy-unit target search radius increased by 0.5 tiles.
sources.limitations: The absolute radius and current value are not published.

sources.title: Changes coming to Ranked Mode & League Modifiers!
facts: Attack range rose from 3.5 to 4.5 tiles and all-level HP increased by approximately 10 to 21 percent.
sources.limitations: Exact post-change HP values, target-search radius and poison effect details are not published.

sources.title: Giftechse: Kosten, Zeiten und Stufen — Clash of Clans
sources.version: Game-file data dated 2026-09-01, processed 2026-09-03; exact client build unpublished
facts: The L1-15 HP and DPS table matches the pinned raw values, confirms 4.5-tile range and 0.35-second attack cadence, and gives TH17 for L11-15.
sources.limitations: No exact client build, poison timing, slow duration, stacking, search radius or Hero-linked lifecycle is supplied.

sources.title: Pinned Poison Lizard Home Village Pet record
facts: Each level has poisonMaxDps, poisonSpeedDecreasePercent and poisonAttackRateDecreasePercent as well as attack damage, DPS and HP.
sources.limitations: The raw record does not identify a current client build, spell-equivalent poison behavior, pulse cadence, duration, stacking or target transition ordering.

derivations.result: Retain poisonMaxDps, poisonSpeedDecreasePercent and poisonAttackRateDecreasePercent as per-level catalogue fields
derivations.method: Lossless normalization of the pinned raw Pet payload; no poison pulses or Core effect are inferred.

derivations.result: Pin dated HP and DPS values
derivations.method: Exact dated game-file table matches pinned raw level values; the official January 2026 change independently supports the range and HP increase, but not exact HP magnitudes.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply a Poison Spell or Headhunter poison implementation to Poison Lizard hits
rejected_inferences.reason: The official Pet description does not establish matching pulse cadence, duration, stacking, reduction rules or target immunity.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use a six-and-a-half-tile enemy-unit search radius
rejected_inferences.reason: The official 2022 patch gives only a 0.5-tile increase, not the starting or current radius; the quoted absolute value is unsourced.
The official introduction explicitly says buildings are not slowed.

rejected_inferences.rule: Spawn a paired Pet actor with generic follow and attack timing
rejected_inferences.reason: The checked sources omit deployment offset, follow geometry, projectile travel, target loss and tick ordering.

items: exact current client build and poison-field continuity
enemy-unit search radius and deterministic target priority
fallback to Hero building target and post-Hero-loss transitions
poison pulse/ramp, duration, stacking, immunity and effect order
projectile launch, impact and target-loss timing
collision, anchors and battlefield art rights

conclusion: Poison Lizard L1-15 remains partial and catalogue-only. Current dated HP/DPS and raw poison effect fields are preserved with provenance; the missing acquisition, poison and paired-Pet timing contract does not support a faithful Core actor.
